translations.en: You explained that you had been deceived,
and that @7rChu Lu Gah@0r's seals had been broken.
Despite the seals being broken, the town remained closed off.
Presumably, the seals protecting the ancient seal
were separate from the seal that imprisoned the town.
For now, the location of the ancient seal remained unknown.
@7rBeatrix@0r and her companions intended to do everything they could to find it.
What you could do now
was hone your skills so that when @7rBeatrix@0r found the labyrinth hiding the ancient seal,
you would be ready to accept that task.
The battle over the imprisoned town was not over yet...
The town was fully freed from its centuries-old curse.
Yet, perhaps because the otherworldly gate's influence lingered, some of the mist
remained, preserving traces of the town's cursed past.
A town containing vast ruins, and a town long held captive by a curse.
Those two legends drew adventurers from far and wide,
and the town soon began to bustle with life.
No one needed to flee this town anymore.
They could live here, in this thriving town.
The otherworldly gate became known, more simply, as the Gate to the Demon Realm,
and @7rChu Lu Gah@0r's reputation as the one who cursed the town
seemed to be gradually clearing.
From the mage who had laid a legendary curse
to the mage who risked his life to save the town...
Even after the sealing circle had been completed,
